useNotes: All four PNG assets are byte-for-byte downloads from the official Pokémon TCG website; no redrawing, recoloring, upscaling, alpha stripping, or cropping.
Each includes its original shaded circular disc and transparent exterior. Render preserving aspect ratio and alpha.
Native raster sizes exceed 128 pixels and are ample for printed attack cost/header use at typical card sizes.
Dragon denotes the Pokémon type. Fire and Water denote attack energy costs. Colorless denotes a cost that any Energy type may satisfy.
These are official third-party Pokémon assets, not original fan artwork or a claim of open licensing.
